response.normalized_query: What is an OCBO Occupancy Permit (Certificate of Occupancy)?

diagnostics.raw_model_answer: An Occupancy Permit is a document required before any building or structure or portion thereof is used or occupied, or the existing use or occupancy classification thereof is changed. This information can be found in the Citizen Charter 2026 under the issuance of Occupancy Permit [S1].
